title: TRACE Duo Exhibition at Lander-Se
summary: Two-artist show at Lander-Se gallery, free entry, running through to 31 May.
editorVerdict: An independent two-hander worth pairing with MPRG, not a destination on its own.
editorNote:
TRACE is two artists in conversation at Lander-Se, one of the Peninsula's quieter independent galleries. Free, closes 31 May.

Use it as the second stop after MPRG, or as a reason to detour if you're already in the area. Address still needs confirming from the gallery directly.
